CALLS.supported: Unique same-owner name-and-arity calls and explicit imported Type.method calls.
CALLS.excluded: Dynamic receiver dispatch, overload type resolution, inheritance dispatch, and reflection.

cases.description: Recognize verified Spring stereotype, constructor injection, and proxy signals without treating similarly named local annotations as Spring.
Require @Bean relationships and conservative same-owner Java CALLS while rejecting dynamic receiver dispatch.

partial_boundary.excluded: Dynamic receiver dispatch such as transport.open().

cases.description: Resolve internal and imported calls but reject a false call edge when a callable name is shadowed by a parameter.
Pipeline roles use lexical tokens rather than misleading substrings.
